newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Dec yr/yr CPI up 2.4 pct (EU method).
newsitem.headline: Danish Dec yr/yr CPI up 2.4 pct (EU method).

text.p: Danish consumer prices were down 0.1 percent in December 1996 from November but 2.4 percent higher than in December 1995, the National Statistics Office said on Tuesday.

The CPI data was issued under new EU-harmonised calculation methods. Under the traditional Danish national formula the respective figures would have fallen 0.1 percent month-on-month and risen 2.3 percent year-on-year.
NOTE - Average analyst expectations were for a 2.4 percent rise from December 1995 according to the national formula.
